Privacy Policy

Last updated: 25 May 2022

Sevelina Games respects the privacy rights of our online visitors and mobile app customers.

Sevelina  games collect no personal data except the data which is performed by the following platforms:

«AppLovin»  (Privacy Policy)
«Google Admob» (Privacy Policy)
«Unity Ads» (Privacy Policy)

Sevelina games show ads which are COPPA-compliant, GDPR-compliant  and suitable for general audiences

 Data Access

Sevelina games don not store your personal data such as email or phone number or any other personal details. Sevelina games focused on offering the best fun to users and not involved in to using this data for marketing purpose or do anything like selling or sharing it anybody else.

 Analytics

Analytics companies like Google or Unity may access anonymous data (such as your IP address or device ID) for performance report purpose and share it with us in aggregate form but this data is not shared as to anybody else.

Proprietary Rights of the Games

All published games under SEVELINA bar are created by SEVELINA, with all proprietary rights. Any part of this website or a game cannot be used without owner permission.
